title: No-Bake Salted Caramel Banoffee Pie
hookLine: Buttery Biscoff biscuit crust, thick dulce de leche caramel, fresh bananas & clouds of cream.

items.name: Crushed digestive or Biscoff + 5 tbsp butter

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {crumb_bn} and {dulce_bn} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Press & Chill Biscuit Base
steps.instructionTemplate: Press {crumb_bn} firmly into a 9-inch tart pan and chill 15 minutes until firm. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {crumb_bn} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.

steps.title: Spread Dulce de Leche, Bananas & Cream
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread {dulce_bn} over chilled crust, layer {banana_bn}, pipe {cream_bn} high, and shave dark chocolate on top. Let No-Bake Salted Caramel Banoffee Pie cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 8 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer No-Bake Salted Caramel Banoffee Pie to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 8 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 15 mins.
